text:
nora: heads-up — deploy-bot flagged a spike of 429s from the post-deploy synthetic for gen-route in us-west after the 09:20 rollout. canary at 5%. tagging eng-releases for quick triage.

deploy-bot: AUTO: postdeploy-synth us-west gen-route: 5/8 failures (HTTP 429). rolling forward paused. logs: /deploy/logs/1779991234/us-west.

sre-bot: quick sampler: failures are 429 from rate-limiter (rl-service) not upstream. p95 latency normal. rate-limiter reject count bumped from 0->3% during canary traffic burst.

ken: did we change rate-limit config in this deploy? I pushed a per-route default earlier this week.

release-coordinator: release manifest shows rl-config:v2 applied with stricter per-ip caps for gen-route. it was intended to protect tenants during high-throughput tests.

ops-bot: checking request headers — synthetic runner uses ephemeral probe IPs, but our RL tier treats them as distinct clients. the canary burst caused many concurrent connections from a small IP set so RL kicked in.

nora: ok mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout and pin canary to 0% (done), 2) temporarily exempt synth runner IP range from per-route RL (ops), 3) re-run synthetics to verify. rollback only if upstream errors occur.

deploy-bot: ACTION: rollout paused by nora. canary traffic set to 0%.

ops-bot: adding exemption for synth runner IP range 10.18.0.0/24 to rl-config on canary. patch applied.

sre-bot: re-running 8 probes at 5s interval.

(10s)

sre-bot: synthetic results: 8/8 success, p95 68ms. 429s stopped.

ken: that confirms config change was the root cause. decision: do not rollback. we should revert rl-config:v2 for gen-route until we have a canary-aware RL rollout process.

release-coordinator: agreed. action items: - eng-platform to add a pre-deploy check that verifies RL changes include exemptions for known internal probe CIDRs (owner: ken) - ops to document synth runner IP ranges in runbook (owner: ops) - product to review RL defaults for low-traffic canaries.

nora: release note: "Post-deploy: transient synthetic failures due to new per-route rate-limiter config interacting with internal synthetic runner IPs. Exempted probe CIDR and resumed rollout. No customer-facing impact."

deploy-bot: AUTO: postdeploy-synth-monitor resolved. canary resumed at 5% per nora.

ken: filing ENGR-2029 for canary-aware RL rollout.

nora: closing thread in 1h if no more regressions. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
